statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93271 (cardiac event monitoring)
The diagnosis codes submitted were I25.10 and I34.0
The patient presented with recurrent episodes of palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
There is a need to correlate clinical events with rhythm disturbances
A cardiac event monitoring study was ordered
The denial reason code was CO-97
The denial was based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure
